name: Irontree Woods
summary: Across northern Felwood, Irontree Woods lies blighted by the scars of the Third War. Its ancient protectors stand petrified among twisted treants and elementals.

sections.title: A Forest Turned to Stone
sections.body:
Irontree Woods lies quiet beneath a demonic stain. During the Third War, the Burning Legion's taint choked life from the soil of this kaldorei glade. The guardian Ancients Hastat, Stoma, and Vartrus fell to dark magic and hardened into stone. Their lifeless forms remain among the corrupted brush.

Maddened treants, vile bog beasts, and tainted water elementals roam the twisted forest floor. They strike at travelers who come near.

faq.q: What happened to the giant trees here?
faq.answer: The great living trees of the night elves, the Ancients Hastat, Stoma, and Vartrus, succumbed to demonic corruption during the Third War. Dark energies turned them to stone, where they remain lifeless.

faq.q: Why are the creatures in the woods hostile?
faq.answer: The Burning Legion's fel corruption has driven the woods' native inhabitants mad. Treants, bog beasts, and water elementals are twisted in mind and form, and attack any outsiders they meet.

faq.q: Can Irontree Woods ever recover from the corruption?
faq.answer: Irontree Woods is deeply warped, and its guardian Ancients are dead and petrified. Hope of recovery rests with the druids working to cleanse the demonic corruption gripping all of Felwood.

faq.q: Who used to care for this grove?
faq.answer: The night elves and their allied Ancients once tended and protected this glade. Kaldorei stonework, relics, and petrified guardian trees remain scattered across northern Felwood.

angles.text: Among the petrified forms of Hastat, Stoma, and Vartrus, you see the toll the Third War took on your sacred woodlands.
Twisted bog beasts and petrified Ancients reveal how far demonic blight has spread. Pure moonwell waters may help renew the tainted soil.
